result.title: DGPExplainer: Generating Prototype Sequence Explanations for Dynamic Graph Neural Networks
result.summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been successfully applied to learning from graph-structured data. However, applying them to dynamic graphs-where nodes and edges evolve over time-presents significant challenges, particularly regarding explainability. While explanation techniques for static GNNs are well established, they do not readily extend to dynamic GNNs (DGNNs) due to the added complexity introduced by temporal dynamics and spatiotemporal dependencies, especially when generating model-level explanations. To address this gap, we introduce DGPExplainer, a post-hoc, prototype-based explainer specifically designed for DGNN models that transforms their complex decision-making processes into human-understandable, analogical, case-based explanations. DGPExplainer first employs local explanation methods to identify important elements within temporal snapshots of dynamic graph sequences. It then decomposes the graph at each time step into distinct prototypes, thereby symbolizing the dynamic graph sequence. Finally, we design a sequence generation method that uses these symbolized sequences to learn and generate class-specific dynamic graph pattern sequences that serve as prototype explanations. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method effectively produces prototype-based explanations for DGNN models across multiple classes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DGPExplainer，一种面向动态图神经网络的事后原型解释器：先用局部解释找出各时间快照中的重要元素，再将图分解为原型以符号化序列，并学习生成类别的动态图模式序列作为解释。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「原型分解＋符号序列生成」可能为 LVR 中将连续推理状态离散为可核查的 prototype 序列、以及按时间步组织证据提供概念线索，但动态图解释设定与视觉多模态推理距离较远，需核查其状态抽象与序列生成方式。
